name: guardskill
title_zh: 开陌生仓库前先查一遍.git和钩子脚本的安检员
tagline_zh: GitSpawn 攻击只需你打开文件夹就执行代码。装它，在 clone、fork、收客户代码后先扫一遍。
tagline_en: GitSpawn executes code just by opening a folder. Install to scan cloned, forked, or client repos before your AI.
desc_en: Scan a project for git settings and hook scripts that make a coding agent execute code when it opens the folder (the GitSpawn research and CVE-2026-45033). Use before opening an unfamiliar, downloaded, forked or client-supplied repository, after merging an outside contribution, and periodically on active projects.
why_zh: 它查的是 git 配置与 hook 脚本这两个最容易被忽略的入口，专治「打开即执行」的隐蔽攻击。
why_en: Targets the overlooked .git config and hooks—the exact vector for open-and-execute attacks. Faster and more thorough than.
limit_zh: 只查 git 相关配置和钩子脚本，不覆盖依赖包、构建脚本或运行时漏洞。
limit_en: Only checks git config & hook scripts, not dependencies, build scripts, or runtime vulns. Needs a local clone with accessible .git.
title_en: Pre-open repo security scan for git config & hook scripts
